base: a37a044edfd8ccf827f917864d87d0ffee4c441d (PR #1599 head, design B after section 47.10)
what: Callgrind Ir of every instructions and rmw_instructions arm at the base, on two instruments that differ only in the C library, with the call records section 47.11's bound reads; and the per-call cost of calloc against malloc for a 40-byte block under each C library

host.cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697 v4 @ 2.30GHz, 2 sockets, 72 threads
host.os: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS host, Linux 5.15; benches run in the containers below
host.role: x86_64 heavy-jobs host; not the reference benchmark host. Callgrind counts are deterministic

provenance.valgrind: 3.27.1, built from https://sourceware.org/pub/valgrind/valgrind-3.27.1.tar.bz2 (sha256 5d589152eb8071c02feab8ce6ab719e431a1fbc3e2b1700f5432632a8b9264dc) inside each image with ./configure --prefix=/opt/valgrind && make && make install, as .github/actions/valgrind does
commands: git archive a37a044e | tar -x into a fresh directory; a fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR per instrument
cargo bench --bench instructions -p expanse-trie; cargo bench --bench rmw_instructions -p expanse-trie

estimators.base: the arm's Callgrind Ir; every profile's total equals the printed count (284 of 286 compared; the two sensor_timestamps arms print under a header the comparison does not parse)
estimators.call_records: parsed from each arm's callgrind.<arm>.<id>.out: for each caller -> callee arc, the calls= count and the inclusive cost line after it. A count includes calls made while collection was off (outside the arm's measured region) whenever the same arc also ran inside it; the cost is the measured region's only. The bound therefore treats a count as exact only where its cost per call is plausible (section 47.11)
estimators.memset: the C library's memset is unnamed in both images (no debug symbols); it is identified as pop_freelist's one callee, 0x163280 (2.41) and 0x189780 (2.39)
estimators.pop_memset_ir: inclusive Ir of pop_freelist's memset calls; pop_hits their count
estimators.suffix_memset_ir: inclusive Ir of new_suffix's memset calls (alloc_raw's zeroing of the runtime-sized block); suffix_memset_calls their count
estimators.shared_shells: calls to new_shell::<true>; shared_shell_pops its calls to pop_freelist; shared_shell_callocs/_ir its calls to calloc
estimators.suffix_callocs: new_suffix's calls to calloc and their inclusive Ir
estimators.suffix_pages: new_suffix's calls to posix_memalign, one per 4096-byte slab page it carves (whose memset stays), and their inclusive Ir (suffix_pages_ir)

allocpc.what: per-call cost of calloc(40, 1) and malloc(40) under each C library, three heap states, 50,000 calls each, one process per (function, state)

page_memset_ir.source: new_shell::<false> -> memset in instructions strmap_insert/routes: 308550 Ir over 75 calls, every one a 4096-byte slab page
new_shell::<false> -> memset in instructions strmap_insert/routes: 308475 Ir over 75 calls, every one a 4096-byte slab page
